map.洪水预警等级对照表，模拟不同水深的影响和应对措施。了解洪水等级，做好防汛准备。: Flood warning-level reference table, simulating the impact and response measures of different water depths. Understand flood levels and prepare for flood control.
map.按水深与流速判定影响：水深 0.3 m 以下行人尚可涉水、0.3 至 0.5 m: Impact is judged by water depth and flow velocity: below 0.3 m pedestrians can still wade, 0.3-0.5 m walking is difficult, above 0.5 m adults easily lose stability, above 1 m can wash away vehicles; if the product of flow velocity and water depth (m2/s) exceeds 0.5 it is dangerous to people; the warning has four escalating levels by blue (minor flood), yellow (larger flood), orange (major flood), red (extreme flood), corresponding to four response measures: prepare, alert, evacuate, withdraw.
map.拖动上方滑块模拟不同水位深度: Drag the slider above to simulate different water depths
map.不同水深的影响与应对: Impact and response of different water depths
map.关注气象和水务部门发布的预警信息: Follow warning information released by meteorological and water-authority departments
map.准备沙袋、挡水板等防汛物资: Prepare flood-control materials such as sandbags and flood boards
map.将贵重物品和电器移至高处: Move valuables and appliances to higher places
map.清理排水沟渠，确保排水畅通: Clear drains and ditches to ensure smooth drainage
map.准备应急包（食物、水、药品、手电筒、救生衣）: Prepare an emergency kit (food, water, medicine, flashlight, life jacket)
map.了解社区疏散路线和避难场所位置: Know the community evacuation route and shelter location
map.不要涉水行走（15cm水深即可使人跌倒，46cm水深可冲走成人）: Don't wade (15cm depth can make an adult fall, 46cm depth can wash away an adult)
map.远离电线和电气设备，防范触电: Stay away from power lines and electrical equipment to prevent electric shock
map.不要驾车通过积水路段（30cm水深可浮起轿车）: Don't drive through flooded sections (30cm depth can float a car)
map.如被困，转移到高处等待救援，发送求救信号: If trapped, move to high ground and wait for rescue, send a distress signal
map.关闭电源和燃气总阀: Turn off main power and gas valves
map.确认官方宣布安全后再返回: Return only after officials declare it safe
map.不饮用未经处理的水，使用煮沸或瓶装水: Don't drink untreated water; use boiled or bottled water
map.清理积水和淤泥，做好消毒防疫: Clear accumulated water and silt, and do disinfection and epidemic prevention
map.检查房屋结构安全，拍照留存损失证据: Check house structural safety, photograph and keep loss evidence
map.关键数据：水深 15cm 可使成人跌倒，30cm 可冲走汽车，60cm 可冲走大: Key data: 15cm depth can make an adult fall, 30cm can wash away a car, 60cm can wash away large vehicles. Never underestimate the power of standing water.
map.洪水水位标尺工具展示洪水预警等级体系，模拟不同水深的影响和应对措施。: The flood water-level gauge tool shows the flood warning-level system, simulating the impact and response of different water depths.
map.汛期关注本地预警时，用标尺对照积水深度预判交通、建筑与人身安全影响。: When following local warnings during flood season, use the gauge to cross-reference standing-water depth and anticipate traffic, building and personal-safety impacts.
map.低洼商铺、车库或地下空间管理者，按预警等级提前部署挡水与转移措施。: Managers of low-lying shops, garages or underground spaces deploy water-blocking and evacuation measures in advance by warning level.
map.社区防汛宣传中，向居民讲解蓝/黄/橙/红/紫各级对应的应对动作。: In community flood-control promotion, explain to residents the response actions corresponding to each blue/yellow/orange/red/purple level.
map.警戒线分级（按积水深度）：≥50cm 蓝色预警（低洼区开始积水，检查排水）；≥1: Warning-line grading (by standing-water depth): ≥50cm blue warning (low-lying areas begin to flood, check drainage); ≥100cm yellow (partial road flooding, lower floors flooded, move valuables, reduce outings); ≥150cm orange (one-story flooding, vehicles impassable, immediately move to high ground); ≥200cm red (multi-story flooding, power outage, emergency evacuation no return); ≥250cm purple (exceeds historical extreme, extreme flood, wait for rescue). Example: a garage forecast to reach 120cm standing water is a yellow warning, so move the car to high ground in advance and prepare flood boards.
map.这个等级看的是降雨量还是积水深度？: Does this level look at rainfall or standing-water depth?
map.本工具按「积水深度」分级，反映已形成的实际淹没情况；气象部门另有基于「降雨量」的: This tool grades by 'standing-water depth', reflecting the actual inundation already formed; meteorological departments separately have rainstorm warnings (blue/yellow/orange/red) based on 'rainfall', the two caliber differ, and for prevention one should combine local real-time water conditions with emergency-management releases for a comprehensive judgement.
map.车库、地下室该怎么防范？: How should garages and basements be protected?
map.达到黄色预警（≥100cm）即应将车辆移至高地，备好挡水板与沙袋，切断地下空间电: Upon reaching yellow warning (≥100cm), move vehicles to high ground, prepare flood boards and sandbags, and cut power to underground spaces; at orange and above, decisively evacuate and never return for belongings - underground spaces easily trap people in floods, and life safety takes priority over property.
